description: 국토교통부_(TAGO)_고속버스정보 [bus and public transit] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 국토교통부. 운영중인 전국 고속버스의 배차정보, 차량정보, 요금정보를 제공하는 서비스 입니다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 국토교통부. Its tags are 고속버스, 고속버스 운행정보, 고속버스 터미널, 고속버스 등급, 고속버스 출발시간. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2026-03-05 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
